script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: Papa says his bakery has one room, a detail not established in his backstory.
The explanation is generic and repeats that the room is not royal without much of Papa's voice.
The explanation repeats that the room is not described as hidden and sounds flat.
Saying the announcement stops the meal adds an action the text does not describe.
The text does not say the moment was quiet; that description is not marked as Papa's guess.
The text does not say that nobody shouts or jumps up.
The capitalized “He's” makes the sentence identify Jesus, rather than the betrayer, as the one dipping his hand into the bowl.
The claim that they are in Jerusalem is a Bible fact not stated in this passage and needs a reference.
The text does not say Jesus' words were quiet.
The explanation is flat and merely repeats that Bethany is not named.
The text does not say they have been in Jerusalem all night. The Jerusalem location also needs a reference outside this passage.
They have already left the table and gone out to the Mount of Olives.
